sources.entry: Llamaport - Run local GGUF models with llama-server. Reads model headers directly for real quantisation and context length, shows the full launch command before starting, reports live token rates and memory pressure, and downloads models from Hugging Face with resume that survives a kill.

summary.one_liner: Llamaport is an unsigned macOS beta app that runs and downloads local GGUF models through llama-server, showing the launch command, live costs, and resumable Hugging Face downloads.
summary.what_it_does: It lists GGUF models in a models folder by reading file headers for quantisation, context length and mixture-of-experts structure, and launches one model at a time with the full llama-server command shown beforehand. Test model runs checks against the running server (process, port, health, model list, alias, a real chat completion) and reports the first-token time. Downloads of .gguf files from Hugging Face use four ranged connections, re-resolve CDN redirects on resume, verify sha256, and refuse servers that do not support ranges. Discover browses Hugging Face GGUF repositories and picks the largest quantisation that fits the GPU's working set, and Activity Monitor lists running llama-server processes with memory and CPU. The README says it never forecasts speed and only reports measured rates.
use_cases: run local GGUF models with llama-server
download large models from Hugging Face with resume
pick a quantisation that fits my Mac's GPU memory
monitor llama-server memory and token speed
test whether a local llama.cpp server is working
browse trending GGUF models on Hugging Face
how_to_run: Download a .dmg from Releases and drag Llamaport to Applications
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Llamaport.app (only if macOS blocks the unsigned build)
notable: Reads GGUF headers directly so quant and context length are real values, not filename guesses
Resumable downloads that re-resolve CDN redirects and verify sha256, surviving kills and reboots
Discover picks the quantisation per model and prints the choice and size on each row
Refuses to pass --host or --port through to llama-server, binding to 127.0.0.1
caveats: Unsigned beta: macOS blocks first launch and needs manual approval or xattr; v0.6.0 and earlier need the xattr command
Universal build has never been run on an Intel Mac; Intel support is untested
macOS only; no Windows or Linux
Public Hugging Face repos only; no token support for gated repos
